title: Strategy and Operations Manager - Central Growth

company.name: Voodoo
company.blurb: Paris-based mobile games and apps publisher, one of the largest hypercasual and hybrid-casual UA operations in the world.

description_md:
**About Voodoo**

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

**Team**

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games and consumer apps.

**Role**

Voodoo is looking for a** Strategy & Operations Manager** to sit in the **Central Growth **department. You will lead key transversal initiatives, venture projects, and play a central role in achieving our vision to build a growth platform that can successfully scale any mobile product globally.

- Become a growth expert: understand growth value chain, user acquisition, creative and monetization needs within a constantly evolving ad-tech ecosystem

- Lead high priority projects within Growth, collaborating with teams across Voodoo

- Enjoy great autonomy to identify critical problems, analyze root causes, design solutions, and implement them

- Design and build leading processes and products

- Work on multiple projects in parallel, requiring you to be highly adaptable

- Projects you might work on include identifying new business opportunities (incl. M&A), leading operational teams, hiring talented people, launching new ventures, etc.

**Profile**

- You graduated from a **top school in engineering or business (Grande Ecole Program)**

- You have 4-6 years of experience in a fast-paced environment (start-up, strategy consulting, investment banking, etc.)

- You are curious, highly analytical, and passionate about having an impact, whatever’s thrown your way

- You wish to work in an environment that values candor, freedom, and responsibility

- You are both fluent in** French and English**

Nice to have:

- You can run your own SQL queries

- You have experience in gaming or performance marketing

**Benefits**

- Competitive salary 

- Premium healthcare (SideCare) for you and your family 100% borne by Voodoo

- Swile Lunch voucher

- Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

- Wellness activities in our Paris office

- Flexible vacation policy

- Remote days

- Child daycare facilities (Les Petits Chaperons rouges)

title: Graphic Designer, Paid Media (Contractor)

company.name: Suno
company.blurb: AI music-creation app letting anyone make songs from a prompt.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **250 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

**About the Role**

Suno is growing fast, and paid social creative is a major driver of that growth. The right person for this role takes Suno's brand identity and pushes it into performance creative that earns attention and converts – work that drives growth and brings the excitement of using Suno to everyone who sees it.

This is a hybrid graphic and motion design role on the performance marketing team. You'll own the branded paid social creative pipeline: conceiving, producing, and iterating on work across static and motion formats. You'll work closely with the performance marketing team, treating data and channel insights as creative inputs rather than afterthoughts. Over time, you'll help build the workflows and systems that let us scale without losing what makes Suno's creative distinctive. As the team grows, there's a path to managing other creative contributors.

Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax

**What You'll Do**

- Translate Suno's brand identity and creative DNA into paid social creative that drives growth across paid channels (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)

- Own the full branded creative pipeline – concepting, producing, and iterating on static and motion assets

- Build and maintain a creative roadmap: what to make, what to test, what to push further, and what to move on from

- Partner with the performance marketing team to use data and channel feedback as creative inputs, not just outputs

- Use AI tools to extend creative output beyond what's manually possible – and help build the processes and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on-brand and up to Suno's standards

- Develop workflows and production processes that scale creative output without diluting brand quality

- Help shape how the next generation of creators discovers Suno – the creative you make is often their first impression

**What You'll NeedMust-Haves**

- 4-6 years in performance creative, paid social design, or growth-focused creative at a consumer tech, DTC, or growth-stage company

- Hybrid graphic and motion design skills: strong static design fundamentals and real motion/animation capability – this is not a pure graphic design role

- Portfolio of paid social work (static and motion) that demonstrates both craft and a performance orientation

- Expert-level proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and After Effects

- Fluency in what makes paid social creative work: hooks, formats, platform conventions, and what drives meaningful iteration

- Ability to internalize a brand's visual identity and push it into new formats without losing what makes it distinctive

**Nice-to-Haves**

- Hands-on experience with AI-assisted creative tools (generative image, video, or copy) as part of a real production workflow

- Background in music, entertainment, or creator-focused consumer products

- Experience managing or mentoring junior creative contributors

Compensation

$75 - $90 per hour

Additional Notes

20-40 hours per week

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Junior Growth Associate

company.name: Homa
company.blurb: Mobile games publisher (hyper/hybrid-casual).

description_md:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**

As a Junior Growth Specialist, you'll play a key role in driving the performance of our live mobile game portfolio. You will work at the intersection of social trends, creative strategy, and AI-powered execution ,  turning what’s working on TikTok and social platforms today into growth momentum for our games tomorrow.

Your main responsibilities will include:

- **Hunt and translate trends** ,  monitor TikTok, ad libraries, and social platforms daily to surface high-potential hooks and turn them into actionable creative strategies for assigned games
- **Own your games** ,  manage growth execution on your assigned live titles, track performance, identify opportunities, and iterate fast based on results
- **Build smarter with AI** ,  use AI tools every day to analyze data, automate workflows, and find new ways to move faster and think bigger
- **Execute with precision** ,  collaborate with the UA and Product teams to launch and optimize test campaigns that drive measurable uplift
- **Push the bar** ,  bring fresh energy, creative thinking, and a relentless desire to find what works ,  then do more of it

This is a great opportunity to own real games from day one, build your growth toolkit in an AI-first environment, and fast-track your career at one of Europe’s most ambitious mobile gaming companies.

**Requirements**

We are looking for someone with a first experience in growth, creative content, or social media, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You’re a great fit if you have:

- **A sharp eye for trends** ,  you live on TikTok, you know what’s going viral and why, and you can connect dots from social culture to a game’s audience
- **An AI-native mindset** ,  you already use AI tools to get things done faster, build processes, and experiment with new approaches without being asked
- **Energy and ownership** ,  you don’t wait to be told what to do; you identify the next thing and go after it
- **A creative, outside-the-box approach** ,  you think differently about problems and get excited by testing new ideas
- **Strong communication skills** ,  you can work across teams, explain your thinking clearly, and align people around a direction

Bonus points if you have:

- Previous experience in ad creatives, performance marketing, or social content production
- Basic exposure to mobile UA, growth hacking, or community building
- Knowledge of tools like Meta Ad Library, UA8, or similar trend/analytics platforms

Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

**Our Culture**

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

- **Humility:** We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
- **Curiosity:** We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
- **Focus:** Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
- **Ambition:** We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

**Benefits**

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

- **🏥 Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
- **🏢 Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
- **🌍 Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
- **🌐 Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
- **✈️ Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
- **📈 Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
- **💻 Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you’re working remotely.

**Where We Hire**

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you’re based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

description_md:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 60 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Performance Marketing Lead

Salary range: €80 000 - 120 000 /annum

We’re looking for a **Performance Marketing Lead** to take full strategic ownership of scaling Almedia's user acquisition to the next level. This pivotal role demands a visionary leader with a proven track record of managing and optimizing large-scale performance marketing operations across diverse channels. You will be directly accountable for aggressive growth targets and multi-million dollar budgets, instrumental in maximizing our overall market footprint and driving significant daily ad spend across **Meta, Google, TikTok**, and beyond.

What You'll Do 🎯

- **Develop & Own Growth Strategy:** Design and execute the overarching performance marketing strategy to achieve ambitious daily ad spend goals (targeting **$100k+ USD/day**), continually optimizing for User Acquisition (UA) and Lifetime Value (LTV).

- **Lead Multi-Channel Execution:** Direct high-budget UA campaigns across a diverse portfolio including **Paid Social (Meta, TikTok)** and **Google Ads (Search, Display, App Campaigns, YouTube)**, ensuring a balanced and high-performing channel mix.

- **Strategic Budget Allocation:** Manage multi-million dollar budgets with full autonomy. You will make data-driven decisions to shift spend toward high-performers and pause underperforming initiatives to ensure optimal ROI and maximum scale.

- **Identify & Launch New Channels:** Proactively research, test, and lead the successful launch of new UA channels from scratch, expanding our reach to untapped audiences and fostering continuous growth.

- **Cross-Functional Growth Leadership:** Collaborate strategically with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative teams to identify new growth levers, improve conversion funnels, and ensure creative assets align with channel-specific best practices.

- **Advanced Analytics & Reporting:** Establish robust measurement frameworks and conduct deep-dive analyses on multi-channel performance. You will translate complex data into executive-level insights that drive immediate strategic action.

What You'll Bring 💡

- **Extensive Strategic Leadership:** Senior-level experience (7+ years) in performance marketing, with a demonstrable track record of scaling UA budgets to **$100k+ USD daily**.

- **Platform Agnostic Expertise:** Deep, hands-on expertise across **Google Ads**, and **App Install Networks**. You understand the unique algorithms and optimization levers of each platform.

- **New Channel Development:** Proven ability to identify and successfully scale new acquisition channels from the ground up.

- **Analytical Rigor:** Proficiency in dissecting complex performance data, building attribution models, and formulating high-impact strategies based on unit economics.

- **Industry Preference:** Experience in **mobile apps, fintech, or gaming** is highly preferred, with a strong grasp of user retention and monetization dynamics.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

- **Growth-Obsessed Strategist:** You are a visionary leader who thrives on unlocking massive scale and pioneering new avenues for user acquisition.

- **Data-Driven & Accountable:** You possess an unparalleled ability to translate data into budget decisions and are fully accountable for delivering on aggressive growth targets.

- **Agile Operator:** You excel in fast-paced environments, capable of pivoting strategies quickly as market dynamics and platform algorithms shift.

**Why Almedia? 🎁**

- **Own Our Growth:** We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

- **Scale With Almedia:** Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

- **Central Berlin Office:** Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

- **Other Benefits:** Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Experienced UA Manager

company.name: TapNation
company.blurb: Hypercasual and hybrid-casual mobile games publisher.

description_md:
**The role**

Take full ownership of user acquisition across a portfolio of games: budgets, creative strategy, and automation. You will be challenged on the ROAS you generate and the scalability of the systems you build, not on the number of campaigns you launch.

**Responsibilities**

Being the game owner of your portfolio including:

- Independently managing UA campaigns across all major networks (Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, Unity, Mintegral, etc.) and running continuous testing.

- Owning the acquisition P&L of your titles: Spend, CPI, D120 ROAS, Margin, LTV, and Payback.

- Driving creative strategy with the creative team: hypothesis design, use of AI generation tools, and systematic analysis of winning and losing concepts

- Closing the loop between UA, monetization, and retention in collaboration with the Data and Product teams

- Building the UA automation infrastructure: budget and ROAS monitoring agents, optimization rules through network APIs, automated reporting and alerting connected to the MMP and the data stack

- Anticipating ecosystem changes (SKAN, privacy, new channels) rather than reacting to them

**Requirements**

- **2 to 5 years of mobile gaming UA experience**, including significant experience in hyper-casual or hybrid-casual

- **A verifiable track record**: you can name the titles you scaled, provide before-and-after figures, and explain precisely what you did

- **Perfect understanding of attribution**: MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer), post-ATT measurement, SKAN ,  you understand the limits of each measurement model and can make sound decisions despite uncertainty

- **Full analytical autonomy**: comfortable with Looker or equivalent, able to build your own LTV models without relying on the data team

- **Demonstrated automation experience**: you have built systems (Python scripts, network APIs, n8n, LLM agents) that run in production, and you can describe them in technical detail

- Fluent English required

This role requires direct ownership of campaigns and budgets. If your automation experience is limited to consuming dashboards, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.

**Nice to have**

- AI agents in production for creative analysis or campaign optimization

- Strong Python skills beyond basic scripting

- Fluent in SQL

- End-to-end experience taking titles from soft launch to global launch

- Set the analytical vision and roadmap for User Growth data science, ensuring the team's work is tightly aligned with company-level priorities and pillar-level goals.

- Lead a team of 6 to 10 data scientists. Build a culture of professional growth, intellectual rigor, creative problem-solving, and shipping impact. Grow the team over time by attracting and hiring outstanding talent.

- Support and evolve the practice of embedding Data Scientists within product development teams, simultaneously maintaining strong stakeholder connection and function cohesion.

- Own the design, execution, and interpretation of experiments and analyses that drive decisions on user acquisition, activation, retention, and reengagement. Improve and advocate for the methodological standards that ensure we learn reliably from every test.

- Develop and maintain user growth forecasting systems. Partner with Finance and Product to deliver credible, timely forecasts of key growth metrics and ensure leadership has the quantitative foundation to set targets and allocate resources.

- Drive business intelligence strategy within Growth, including the metrics layer, self-serve dashboards, and the analytical infrastructure that enables others to operate with data fluency.

- Translate complex analytical findings into clear narratives for senior leadership and cross-functional partners. Influence strategic decisions through a combination of technical depth and effective communication.

- Collaborate across organizational boundaries with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Finance to elevate every phase of product development.

**✅  You have...**

- Experience using data science and analytics to solve product and business problems.

- Experience managing 5+ person data science teams.

- A graduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent demonstrated expertise in formal analytical techniques.

- Applied industry experience using causal inference, experimentation, and/or machine learning models. You routinely use analytical tools in messy real world settings where details, confounds, and the validity of assumptions matter.

- Proven ability to build, lead, and grow a high-performing data science team. You have a track record of hiring well, developing people across levels, managing performance, and creating an environment where talented scientists do their best work.

- Strong command of SQL, Python or R, and data/analytics engineering ecosystems. You do not need to write production pipelines, but you need to go deep when the work requires it.

- Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to distill complex quantitative work into crisp, actionable insights for diverse audiences.

**⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...**

- Experience operating at a high-growth, data-intensive consumer technology company.

- Experience developing and implementing a long-range analytical vision that shaped product strategy and business outcomes.

- Demonstrated success in building forecasting systems or attribution models at scale.

- Experience navigating the transition from growth-stage to scaled public company, including the analytical demands that come with investor-grade reporting and forecasting.

- Experience with AI and machine learning as applied to user behavior modeling, notification optimization, or personalization.

- An impressive Duolingo streak.

description_md:
**ABOUT CODEWAY**

Codeway is a global consumer tech company with more than 400M users worldwide.

Since 2020, we’ve built and scaled 60+ mobile apps across creativity, productivity, wellness, language learning, and entertainment.

Our flagship apps ,  Retake AI, Cleanup, Learna, and DramaPops ,  and many of them lead their categories globally. In 2024, we became the most downloaded app publisher on iOS, driven by cutting-edge AI research, sharp data-driven execution, and a relentless focus on product and marketing.

We’re a team of 300+ people across İstanbul and Barcelona who bring curiosity, passion, trust, and ownership to everything we build. Recognized as a #1 LinkedIn Top Startup and a Great Place to Work in Europe, Codeway is where ambitious people do their life’s best work.

We’re building the next generation of consumer tech and reimagining what mobile apps can be.

This is Codeway. This is our way. Join us.

**
POSITION**

At Codeway, we're redefining the performance marketing role. Here, you won't just analyze data and optimize campaigns; you'll also participate in creative discussions, manage global network relationships, and contribute to strategic decisions that shape Codeway’s future vision.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional all-rounder: good with people, comfortable with data, a self-starter who’s not afraid of failing, capable of generating creative ad ideas, and deeply curious about all aspects of growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

- **Claim 360 ownership** of an app’s marketing & execute end-to-end user acquisition strategies.

- **Manage the Creative Pipeline.** Develop and test creatives: come up with ideas, propose hypotheses, monitor implementation, and give feedback.

- **Manage and optimize user acquisition campaigns** across Meta, TikTok, Google and other networks.

- **Build meaningful relationships** with external partners and agencies, and manage collaborations with ad networks such as Meta London, TikTok Dubai, Apple London, and Google Dublin teams.

- **Build and monitor BI dashboards** for insights, and ensure campaigns achieve target KPIs while scaling.

- **Collaborate closely with the product team** to understand user motivations and shape effective monetization strategies.

- **Take additional responsibilities **to grow your app. Get creative, think beyond performance marketing, and apply out-of-the-box growth-hacking techniques.

**
WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

- **Experience.** You have 0-1 year of experience, are eager to take your first steps in this field, and are open to learning.

- **Passion.** Passion for mobile marketing, data, creative production.

- **Take the wheel.** You’re ready to get your hands dirty. You’re hard-working, you refuse to give up until achieving what you want to get. You’re result-driven and always aim for excellence in the work you do.

- **Ownership.** We want you to be ready to own every aspect of your project. You won’t be a newcomer here; you’ll own your thing.

- **Cool vibe.** You’re open to constructive criticism and feedback. You’re ready to improve yourself accordingly.

- **Excellent communication skills.** You’ll wear multiple hats as you work with marketing artists, product managers, external partners, and your peers within the performance team.

- **Excellent command of English.** You’ll manage a creative pipeline that mainly targets the United States audience, and manage joint partnerships with external networks and agencies.

 

**WHAT WE OFFER**

· **Top of the market compensation package:** Long story short, we take care of you.

· **A Meal Compensation.** That is actually enough for a decent & nutritious lunch, we’re not following the industry standard.

· **Full Health Benefits.** To keep you away from all the trouble, we provide unlimited private health insurance and cover the HPV vaccine.

· **Pet Adoption Support.** We cover the primary healthcare expenses, parasite vaccinations, and microchip costs that may arise within the first year after employees adopt a pet.

· **Cool Tech Stack.** Macbook, iPhone 15 Pro, magic mouse, magic keyboard; an adjustable desk with a 4K screen and any other gadget you may need in your job.

· **Sport Activities Support.** We care about your physical wellbeing and support your gym membership.

· **Flexible Schedule.** This isn’t a “clock in, clock out” company. We care about your productivity, not tracking every minute you’re on site. It’s up to you to always be responsible with your work, no matter where you are or what schedule you’re keeping.

· **English Course Support.** Be more global and perform best at your work.

· **A Top-Notch Office.** Located at the heart of Barcelona in the iconic Edifici Estel.

· **Codebrew.** Yes, you’ve heard it right: We love coffee so much that we’ve built our own coffee shop inside our office, where we also provide healthy snacks at all hours.

· **Free Breakfast & Lunch.** At Codebrew - every day.

· **No Dress Code.** Dress as you like.

· **Dream Team.** Average Codeway member is young, talented, and passionate - which makes our working environment extremely dynamic. Need proof? Take a look at our Instagram.

· **Gaming Area.** Whenever you need to take a break from hard work and relax with your favorite games, our PS5 corner will be waiting for you.

· **Software Support.** Subscription to any software you might need to perform at your best.

· **Public Transportation Support.** Daily public transportation support is on us, covered by an additional monthly compensation.

**
THE RECRUITING PROCESS**

We are committed to keeping our recruitment process short and transparent. Here’s how it looks like:

- **Application:** Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. You can also just write a few words about yourself.

- **Talent & Culture Interview:** Let’s talk about your experience & expectations and see what we can achieve together.

- **Case Study:** We might send you a task to solve.

- **Technical Interview:** You will meet with future team lead to go over the case and your technical capabilities in detail.

- **Final Interview:** A final interview with one of our senior leaders.

- **Welcome Aboard!** You are now a part of the team.

Your personal data that will be collected through your applications made due to this advertisement will be processed automatically by the data controller Codeway in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK") and relevant legislation for the purpose of conducting job application processes. You can access detailed information on this matter from the **"Candidate Information Notice"**page at https://www.codeway.co. Codeway processes the personal data of job applicants in accordance with relevant legislation. "**Privacy Notice for Employee Candidate**" summarizes the data processing procedures during the application process.

title: Performance Marketing Manager

company.name: AppLovin
company.blurb: Mobile app growth and monetisation platform with its own portfolio of apps and games.

description_md:
About AppLovin

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

**About Gist**

Gist is a new social media platform for people who want substance ,  practical, thoughtful content that spans philosophy debates, city-specific recommendations, seasonal gift guides, and wellness tips. Across categories like travel, food, career, and family, we describe it as "a handbook for the curious."

Gist is built by AppLovin Corporation ,  a company that hit $5.3B in revenue last year and sits alongside Google and Meta as one of the world's leading ad tech platforms. Fortune recognizes AppLovin as one of the Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and the company has been a Certified Great Place to Work for the last four years (2021–2024).

**The Role**

We're hiring a founding Performance Marketing Manager to own all of paid growth for Gist ,  every channel, every dollar, every partnership. You'll set the performance marketing strategy, build the measurement foundation, and run the testing loops across Meta, TikTok, Google, and programmatic that give us real control over CAC from day one. No team to delegate to, no playbook to inherit. You are the expert in the room, and everything paid runs through you.

**What You'll OwnEvery paid channel.** You are the channel manager across the full performance marketing mix: Meta, TikTok, Google, programmatic, ad networks, and any emerging channel worth testing. You decide where we spend, how much, and why ,  and you live with the results.

**Off-platform partnerships.** Beyond self-serve ad platforms, you will identify, negotiate, and manage relationships with external partners ,  media companies, OEM and on-device distribution partners, ad networks, affiliate and performance platforms, publisher direct buys, and other non-standard acquisition channels. You own these relationships end-to-end: partner evaluation, deal structure, execution, and ongoing performance management.

**Budget and efficiency. **Own the monthly performance marketing budget with full accountability to CAC, CPI, LTV, and ROAS. Allocate across channels and partners dynamically based on performance, scale what works, cut what doesn't, and report spend decisions clearly to leadership.

**Measurement and analytics.** Work on tracking setup to extract meaningful signal ,  diagnosing performance shifts, identifying what's working and what isn't, and translating data into clear actions. You are comfortable going deep into the numbers independently, spotting anomalies before they become problems, and working cross-functionally with product, data, and engineering teams to investigate and resolve issues collaboratively.

**Creative and channel testing.** Run structured tests across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, ad formats, and partner inventory. Treat every campaign and partnership as a hypothesis. Document what you learn and build a compounding playbook over time.

**The full funnel.** You are accountable not just for installs but for quality users. Partner with product and growth teams to understand post-install behaviour, feed those insights back into performance marketing strategy and creative direction, and optimise toward activation and retention, not just volume.

**New distribution thinking.** A new social platform lives or dies by how it finds its first million users. Beyond standard channels, you will proactively explore non-obvious distribution: influencer/KOL paid amplification, content seeding partnerships, cross-platform distribution deals, incentivised install ecosystems, and anything else early data suggests is worth testing.

**What We're Looking For**

● 3-7 years of brand-side performance marketing experience, with direct ownership of budgets and outcomes for a consumer app, marketplace, or digital product

● Proven experience driving growth from cold start ,  you have launched performance marketing for a new product or market from zero, not just optimised an existing system, and you know what it takes to find the first users before there is any data to work with

● Hands-on fluency across Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Google Ads; programmatic and ad network experience a strong plus

● Demonstrated experience managing off-platform or non-self-serve partnerships ,  ad networks, OEM or device partnerships, media direct buys, affiliate or performance platforms, or similar; you have negotiated deals and managed these relationships independently

● Mobile attribution tooling experience with Adjust or equivalent; able to set up and own measurement infrastructure end-to-end, not just read reports someone else configured

● Thinks in the right metrics: CAC, CPI, LTV, ROAS, Day 7/30 payback, and funnel conversion rates ,  and can diagnose when numbers move and why

● Strong negotiation and partner management skills; comfortable building and managing external vendor and partner relationships independently

● Senior individual contributor mindset ,  you thrive working independently, go deep on execution without needing a team beneath you, and bring enough seniority to set strategy and defend decisions to leadership without hand-holding

**Nice to Have**

● Experience running performance marketing specifically for a social, entertainment, or consumer app

● Exposure to influencer or KOL-driven paid amplification as an acquisition channel

● Familiarity with incrementality testing, geo-splits, or media mix modelling

● SQL or BI tool fluency (Looker, Tableau, Metabase) for self-serve analysis

**What We Offer**

● Top-of-market compensation

● Full ownership of a critical function from day one, inside a company with the infrastructure, ad tech depth, and platform relationships to back you up

● A lean, high-trust environment where decisions move fast and your impact is direct and visible

AppLovin provides a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance rewards approach. Total compensation at AppLovin is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Depending on the position offered, equity, and other forms of incentive compensation (as applicable) may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to dental, vision, and other benefits.

**Other Types of Pay:** Equity eligible

**Health Insurance: **Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability

**Retirement Benefits:** 401(k) Retirement Plan

**Paid Time Off:** Unlimited Discretionary Time Off

**Paid Holidays:** 10 paid holidays per year

**Paid Sick Leave:** 80 hours per year

**Method of Application:** Apply online

**Application Window:** The application window is expected to close within 30 days of the posting date.

All questions or concerns about this posting should be directed to peopleops@applovin.com.

$119,000, $179,000 USD

description_md:
**500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.**

Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.

With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.

**The job**

As a Motion /Video Designer at Flo, you create compelling animated content that brings ideas to life, edit thumbstopping UGC videos, strengthen brand storytelling, and contribute to impactful marketing initiatives. Your work supports a variety of channels across paid UA, helping to communicate key messages through high-quality motion design that aligns with Flo’s visual identity and purpose.

**Responsibilities/tasks**

- Boost motion design capacity by swiftly creating and animating graphics and editing videos in response to campaign demand spikes.

- Collaborate with the UA team to deliver high-quality motion assets aligned with fast-changing priorities.

- Adapt existing designs and produce rapid iterations for spontaneous creative requests.

- Address localization needs to tailor motion graphics and videos for different global markets.

- Produce static ads & thumbnails where required

- Experiment with generative AI tools to explore new video concepts and improve workflow efficiency.

- Maintain consistency with brand guidelines across all visual content.

- Deliver visually compelling work that effectively communicates app features and user benefits.

Animation concept development, leveraging brand's characters, app UI, typography, illustration and look & feel, to deliver fresh new video and animation ideas.

Storyboarding concepts on Figma, demonstrating proficient use of colour, illustration, Typography and app UI elements

Communicating with stakeholders and team members to meet deadlines successfully

Key results/objectives

- Deliver high-quality motion graphics and videos that meet deadlines and support UA our goals.

- Improve campaign engagement and performance through effective motion storytelling.

- Integrate innovation in tools and workflows, including AI applications, to elevate creative output.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience in motion design with a strong portfolio showcasing animation skills and editing techniques.

- Proficiency in Adobe After Effects and other motion design software.

- Proficiency in Adobe CC.

- Proficiency in Figma or similar software.

- Strong understanding of animation principles and visual effects.

- A strong eye for detail, with an understanding of brand guidelines and the ability to maintain consistency across motion graphics.

- Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including copywriters, designers, and marketers.

- Understanding of basic performance marketing concepts (e.g., CTR, conversion rates).

- Ability to manage multiple design projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Excellent communication skills for clear and effective collaboration.

- Genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for experimenting with AI tools, including generative AI video platforms, to push creative boundaries and elevate video storytelling.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience in the tech or digital marketing industry.

- Experience creating static ads to compliment motion & video skills

- Experience in the femtech, health, and wellbeing sector.

- Familiarity with Cinema 4D or 3D motion design (a plus).

- Basic understanding of user acquisition (UA) and CRM creatives

Salary from 3400-3600 EUR

#LI-Remote

**How we work**

We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We move fast, stay focused and take ownership – from brief to build to impact. Debate is encouraged. Decisions are shared. We care about craft, ship with purpose, and always raise the bar.

You’ll be working with people who take their work seriously, not themselves. It takes commitment, resilience, and the drive to keep going when things get tough. Because better health outcomes are worth it.

**What you'll get**

We support impact with meaningful reward. Here’s what that looks like:

- Competitive salary and annual reviews

- Opportunity to participate in Flo’s performance incentive scheme

- Paid holiday, sick leave, and female health leave

- Enhanced parental leave and pay for maternity, paternity, same-sex and adoptive parents

- Accelerated professional growth through world-changing work and learning support

- In-person collaboration and work in a hybrid model, with 3 days per week spent in the office

- 5-week fully paid sabbatical at 5-year Floversary

- Flo Premium for friends & family, plus more health, pension and wellbeing perks

**Diversity, equity and inclusion**

Our strength is in our differences. At Flo, hiring is based on merit, skill and what you bring to the role – nothing else. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, communities and identities. Read our privacy notice for job applicants.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

More than 100 million people have made music with Suno, and for many of them, the journey started with an ad. This role writes those first impressions: the hooks, headlines, and scripts that introduce music-making to people scrolling Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, people who never thought of themselves as musicians until your line stopped them.

You’ll work hand in hand with our growth marketing team, sharpening creative briefs, writing the copy that ships in them, and putting your ideas in front of a massive global audience within days of writing them. You’ll also get to build: AI-powered tools and workflows that turn your best instincts into something the whole team can run on. Over time, your canvas can grow into email marketing, SEO, and ASO.

This is a role for a writer with serious range: someone who can write a clean brand line, a Daily Mail-style headline, a TMZ tease, and a direct-response hook, and knows exactly why each one converts. If you think in audiences, angles, and hooks, and you want to see what your words can do at real scale, we’d love to meet you.

Here's a song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/V5a09xoilFTsd3hN

What You’ll Do

- Write high-impact copy for paid social ads across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok: hooks, headlines, primary text, and scripts.

- Review briefs from the growth team and sharpen the copy inside them before they go to production.

- Help shape the copywriting frameworks and playbooks our growth team runs on.

- Build AI-powered tools and workflows that make strong copy repeatable at scale.

- Use creative testing and performance data to learn what wins and sharpen the next round of copy.

- Expand into email marketing and SEO copy over time.

What You’ll Need

Must-Haves

- **A killer portfolio **of direct-response copy written for live Meta and/or TikTok campaigns, with results you can speak to.

- **Serious headline range**, from clean brand lines to Daily Mail / TMZ-style hooks that stop the scroll, written straight.

- **Performance training**, a real grasp of why an ad wins or loses: audiences, angles, and hooks, not just wordsmithing.

- **Volume at pace**, proven ability to produce many strong copy variants fast without the quality falling off.

- **Hands-on AI fluency**, you already use AI tools to build repeatable copy systems, not just draft one-offs.

- **Self-direction with coachability**, you can run solo off a brief, take direction well, and get to a great output fast.

- **A proactive mindset**, you spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

**Nice-to-Haves**

- Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

This is a month-to-month contract role on 30-day terms, paying $75 to $120 per hour depending on experience, at roughly 10 to 20 hours per week to start, with room to scale to 20 to 40 hours as the engagement grows.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

- **Impact not job titles: **We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- **Excellence everywhere: **Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- **Global team: **We prioritize your talent, not your location.

- **Growth paths: **Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

ElevenReader is our fast-growing consumer audio app, and creative is one of our biggest growth levers. We’re looking for a Creative Producer to deliver creative marketing campaigns, experiments, and to build the creative engine that powers performance marketing across every major acquisition channel.

- Partnering closely with Performance Marketing and agencies to rapidly iterate and scale winning campaigns

- Continuously improving our creative production pipeline through AI automation, reusable templates, and scalable workflows

- Raising the creative quality bar while ensuring every asset is designed to maximize measurable business outcomes

- Expert proficiency in Figma, CapCut, Adobe Suite and modern AI creative tools and generative media platforms

**Bonus**

description_md:
**About ElevenLabs**

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**

- **High-velocity: **Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- **Impact not job titles: **We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company, from engineering to growth to operations.

- **Excellence everywhere: **Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- **Global team: **We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**

- **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- **Growth paths: **Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- **Learning & development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- **Annual company offsite: **Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- **Co-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

**About the role**

ElevenReader is our fastest growing app that brings content to life for consumers. As we scale globally, we need a Growth Marketer who can turn creative ideas and strategic partnerships into one of our most powerful acquisition channels.

You’ll own the strategy and execution of growth campaigns that bring millions of new users to ElevenReader through partnerships, integrated marketing, and innovative activations. Think: loyalty programs, co-marketing campaigns, OOH activations, offer-based collaborations, retail partnerships, and testing entirely new distribution channels.

This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of growth marketing, creative, partnerships, and performance marketing. You’ll develop creative campaigns, launch new acquisition channels, build scalable partnership playbooks, and rigorously measure what works. You’ll work closely with Performance Marketing to ensure every activation drives measurable full-funnel user growth while strengthening the ElevenReader brand.

**What you will do**

- Building and scaling strategic consumer partnerships that drive acquisitions for ElevenReader

- Developing integrated marketing campaigns spanning partnerships, paid media, email, social, OOH, PR, and product surfaces

- Expanding existing telecom & loyalty partnerships while launching new opportunities with partnersIdentifying and launching new distribution channels across loyalty platforms, retail, education, public sector, travel, and commerce.

- Creating bundled value propositions that make ElevenReader a compelling consumer benefit or offer

- Managing co-marketing campaigns with strategic partners from creative development through launch and post-campaign analysis

- Writing compelling campaign messaging, design copy, landing pages, and emails/push that convert

- Partnering with Design to produce best-in-class creative assets while maintaining exceptional brand quality

- Measuring campaign performance across attribution models, incrementality, CAC, LTV, retention, and ROAS, continuously optimizing for business growth

**Requirements**

- 5+ years of experience in growth marketing, partnerships, consumer marketing, or integrated marketing at a high-growth technology or consumer company

- Exceptional growth marketing instincts ,  equally comfortable developing creative campaigns and analyzing acquisition performance

- Experience launching and scaling partnership marketing programs that drive measurable user acquisition

- Strong understanding of attribution, experimentation, ROAS, incrementality, and performance analytics

- Excellent copywriting skills with an eye for memorable campaigns and high-converting, differentiated messaging.

- Strong creative judgment and taste. You know what great marketing looks like and can work effectively with designers and creative teams.

- Outstanding project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple cross-functional launches simultaneously.

**Bonus**

- Experience with lifecycle and loyalty marketing programs that improve acquisition and retention

- Experience with performance marketing and affiliates

- Curiosity about emerging distribution opportunities and the creativity to turn unconventional partnerships into scalable growth channels.

- Passion for consumer products, AI, and building globally loved brands.

**Location**

This role is remote with a preference for timezones in US - East and Europe

title: Freelance Motion Designer (Mobile Games)

company.name: Homa
company.blurb: Mobile games publisher (hyper/hybrid-casual).

description_md:
**Homa** is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

Mission

**Engagement type:** This is a freelance, project-based role with flexible contract durations.

As a** FreelanceMotion Designer**, you'll play a key role in elevating the quality and performance of our game creatives.

You will report directly to a Creative Producer and partner closely with creative developers and other motion designers to drive high-quality creative production and contribute to how Homa scales its creative capabilities. This is a great opportunity to own your creative output end-to-end, work on ambitious and high-impact projects, and push both your technical and creative limits in a fast-paced environment.

Your main responsibilities will include:

- **Produce high-quality video creatives in 2D and 3D: **own the full production of engaging, polished assets that meet a high visual bar and capture player attention
- **Deliver strong visual storytelling through motion: **using composition, color, animation principles, and staging to create emotionally engaging and high-performing creatives
- **Work across a modern production stack (After Effects, Blender, Unity)**: collaborating closely with creative developers and adapting to technical workflows beyond traditional motion design
- **Leverage AI and new technologies to optimize production: **identifying when and how to use AI tools effectively to increase speed while maintaining creative control
- **Contribute ideas and push creative boundaries: **bringing your own perspective, proposing concepts, and helping the team continuously improve quality and innovation

**Requirements**

We are looking for someone with 3+ years of **experience as a Motion Designer in mobile games**, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

- **Strong hands-on experience in motion design across 2D and 3D**, producing high-quality video ads for mobile games with a strong focus on driving performance and cracking marketability
- **Experience in mobile gaming or ad creative production,** in environments known for strong creative output
- **Proficiency using tools such as Unity, After Effects, and Blender, **among others
- **A sharp visual eye and strong animation fundamentals**, including composition, color theory, motion quality, and animation principles (such as the Disney 12 principles), with the know-how to turn all of that into engaging content
- **The ability to work autonomously **and deliver with limited feedback, bringing a strong quality bar, navigating ambiguity with ease, and making smart decisions on how to approach and execute creative tasks
- **A strong understanding of modern production workflows**, including how to balance speed and quality, choose the right tools, and structure your work efficiently in a fast-paced environment
- **A proactive mindset and strong team spirit,** staying motivated in test-and-learn environments, bringing positive energy, and contributing to a team that is constantly pushing for better results

Bonus if you have:

- **Experience using AI tools in production**, with an understanding of how to leverage AI for image, video, and workflow optimization, and when to use it to gain efficiency without losing control over quality
- **Creative ideation experience**, with the ability to propose ideas, challenge briefs constructively, and bring your own perspective on what could work from a creative or market standpoint
- **Hand drawing skills**, with the ability to produce storyboards, sketches to present ideas, and strong illustrations, among other things

**Benefits**

At **Homa**, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

- **Humility:** We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
- **Curiosity:** We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
- **Focus:** Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
- **Ambition:** We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

**Where We Hire**

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Creative Strategist

company.name: Greenlight
company.blurb: Family finance and debit-card app for kids and teens.

description_md:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products ,  including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub ,  brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.

At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

We are looking for a **Senior Creative Strategist** to lead the thinking behind our creative. This person will own the strategic point of view that shapes every brief, turning internal data and cultural signals into a clear creative direction our editors and creators can run with. You'll be the person in the room asking "why this, why now, why does it matter to our audience".

This is a strategy focused role. We need someone who can look at performance data, platform trends, and audience behavior, and translate that into sharp, actionable briefs.

**Your day-to-day:**

- Write creative briefs autonomously, grounding every recommendation in internal performance data and emerging online/cultural trends

- Develop a clear strategic rationale for each brief: what we're making, who it's for, why it will work, and how we'll know

- Accurately assess and analyze performance data (content, campaign, and platform level) to identify what's working, what's not, and why

- Translate analysis into forward looking recommendations

- Partner closely with editors to prioritize and champion strong visual strategy, giving clear feedback rooted in strategic intent

- Help ensure the "why" behind a creative choice is understood, not just the "what"

- Identify and help source content from creators, evaluating fit against brand and campaign strategy

- Work directly with creators to ensure output aligns with the brief and Greenlight's voice

- Partner with the internal brand team on asset exchange and alignment, ensuring creative stays consistent with broader brand strategy

- Act as a strategic connective tissue between data, brand, editorial, and creator relationships

**What you’ll bring to the team:**

- 5+ years of experience in creative strategy, content strategy, or a related role, ideally with exposure to both data analysis and creative production

- A track record of writing briefs that lead to creative work, not just documentation of requests

- Strong analytical skills; comfortable in data/analytics tools and confident drawing conclusions from them

- A sharp eye for visual strategy and the ability to give editors direction that improves the work

- Experience sourcing or managing creator relationships/content

- Excellent collaborator able to work across brand, editorial, and creative teams and keep everyone aligned to the same strategy

- Strong written communication; briefs need to be clear, persuasive, and easy to act on

- Self starter who can work autonomously and drive briefs from insight to output with minimal oversight

**Nice to have:**

- Experience in fintech, family finance, or consumer subscription products

- Familiarity with short form/social content trends and platform specific creative strategy

- Experience working with creator/influencer networks at scale

**Work perks at Greenlight:**

- Medical, dental, vision, and HSA match

- Paid life insurance, AD&D, and disability benefits

- Traditional 401k with company match

- Unlimited PTO

- Paid company holidays and pop-up bonus holidays

- Professional development stipends

- Mental health resources

- 1:1 financial planners

- Fertility healthcare

- 100% paid parental and caregiving leave, plus cleaning service and meals during your leave

- Flexible WFH, both remote and in-office opportunities

- Fully stocked kitchen, catered lunches, and occasional in-office happy hours

- Employee resource groups

title: Paid Social Creative Strategist (Contract)

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **200 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is the role that decides what that creative is and why: the strategist who turns audience insight into the concepts everyone else executes. You’ll lead the audience and market research that uncovers new angles, pain points, and use cases, then turn them into a steady backlog of concepts and briefs that designers and editors run with across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

This is a high-ownership role with real strategic latitude. You won’t be handed a brief and told to fill it, you’ll write the briefs. You’ll bring your own read on which audiences are worth chasing, what story wins them, and which formats to test, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your concepts quickly enough to act on them.

If you think in audiences and angles, read hook rate and hold rate as fluently as you spot a fresh one, and want your concepts running in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you.

What You’ll Do

- Lead deep audience and market research to uncover new personas, pain points, and use cases worth targeting.

- Turn that research into a steady backlog of net-new ad concepts, each with a clear rationale for why it should win.

- Write sharp creative briefs that give designers, editors, and producers a clear direction to execute against.

- Develop angles, hooks, and messaging built around how people actually behave on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

- Define what to test next and why, isolating variables so every result teaches us something.

- Keep a deep bench of fresh ideas in flight to stay ahead of creative fatigue, so no single winner carries the account too long.

- Partner with performance marketing managers to turn account needs into concrete creative direction.

- Read performance signals and feed them back into sharper concepts, as bandwidth allows.

What You’ll Need

**Must-Haves**

- Proven experience as a creative strategist in a high-volume, high-velocity performance creative environment.

- A strong track record of paid social creative for live Meta and/or TikTok campaigns, with results you can speak to.

- A real grasp of direct-response creative: audiences, angles, hooks, and why an ad wins or loses, not just how it looks.

- Deep fluency in audience and market research, and the instinct to turn it into non-obvious angles.

- The range to own strategy end to end and the scrappiness to write the hooks and do the research yourself. No task is beneath you.

- A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

- Fluency in Motion (or a comparable creative analytics tool) to read what’s driving performance and act on it.

- Comfort reading metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and turning them into the next round of concepts.

**Nice-to-Haves**

- Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

- Comfort folding AI tools into research and ideation to move faster.

- A love of music and an eye for culture.

**Compensation**

This is a contract role paying $80 to $120 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.

**Additional Notes**

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. - Proven track record of scaling paid programs profitably across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other channels

- Hands-on platform expertise, you’ve personally built and optimized campaigns, not just managed an agency

- Strong analytical chops, you understand attribution, tracking, and LTV vs CAC math without needing a second opinion

- Clear communicator with the ability to write high-intent copy and brief creative

- You thrive in scrappy, high-ownership environments and are confident building systems from the ground up

Bonus

Creative Strategy Intern ,  Wildlife

We are looking for a Creative Strategy Intern to join the Creative Strategy team at Wildlife. This is a role for someone at the start of their career who is curious about markets, excited by data, and wants to learn how strategic reads turn into creative decisions that drive performance at scale.

You will learn to use AI to multiply your output, feed structured signal into the system, and start building the judgment to curate what comes out.

What you'll do

- You will help maintain a continuous read of competitors, market trends, and network behavior across TikTok, Meta, and others, learning to turn that read into inputs for briefs and decisions. You will get hands-on with intelligence tools like Sensor Tower and internal data to understand what we test, scale, and abandon.

- You will support the team in authoring briefs, learning the craft of briefing: the highest-leverage moment of the creative cycle. You will follow the production handoff with the Studio team and start developing the taste and judgment to tell good work from great.

- You will help read creative performance across metrics like Spend Share, IPM, CTR, CPI, ROAS, hook and hold rates, learning to spot patterns and translate them into the next round of bets. You will help document learnings into the team's structured knowledge base so insight compounds over time.

What you'll need

- Mandatory: Expected graduation between July 2027 and December 2027. Applications outside this window will not be considered.

- Genuine curiosity about markets, consumer behavior, and what makes creative work.

- Comfort working with data and a willingness to dig into metrics and spreadsheets to find the story.

- Comfort with AI as part of your daily workflow ,  you don't need to be technical, but you should treat AI tools as leverage, not curiosity.

- Strong written and verbal communication, in English and Portuguese.

- Personal projects, coursework, or internships involving marketing, data analysis, or content/creative.

- Interest in mobile gaming, app marketing, or consumer products operating at scale.

- Any exposure to A/B testing, motion design, video, or playable ads.

More about you

- You are curious about the market by default. You notice what works, you have opinions about ads, and you like understanding why.

- You are developing taste and want to sharpen it. You're starting to tell good from great and you want to learn to articulate why.

- You like connecting the dots between a spreadsheet, a brief, and a conversation about the game.

- You are pragmatic about iteration. You don't get attached to your ideas ,  you get attached to learning.

- You write clearly and communicate with precision. People leave conversations with you knowing what you mean.

- You stay curious and calm in a fast-moving environment where the plan changes often.
